gen-gf-baumans-gf-shanti: Shanti is modern and open, with a generous entry into the e's eye. But Baumans is where the commanding presence lives, its o a ring with a constant wall, while Shanti handles the steady reading.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-shippori-antique: Wide-mouthed and sturdy, Baumans swings its c open like a crescent wrench, every stroke a single thickness. And short lines set big are where it earns its place, while Shippori Antique tips its bowls open like a ladle.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-shippori-antique-b1: A wrench-wide c up top, daylight below: Baumans commands with strokes of a single thickness. And Shippori Antique B1 lets text move along easily, light showing through every curve like a fixed-width brush line.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-sn-pro: SN Pro is a modern sans-serif whose curves stay open throughout the alphabet, giving the text plenty of light to move through. Baumans hits harder up top, its diagonals matching the verticals in weight.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-snippet: Baumans is commanding and distinctive, its c swung wide like a crescent wrench. And it earns its keep big and short, while Snippet brings an approachable, wire-bent look to the words around it.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-source-sans-3: Blunt and monoweight, Baumans takes charge with a c like a crescent wrench opened wide. Source Sans 3 lets the lower bowl of its a breathe, so it holds up a few sizes below the heading.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-spinnaker: Commanding from the first letter, Baumans draws lines that are not heavier on the downstrokes. But made small, its crescent-wrench c loses its force, while Spinnaker's apertures keep counters connected to the outside.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-stick: Distinctive up top, Baumans swings its c like a crescent wrench. What holds it together is line: Stick's tubelike, constant-weight strokes and its wide exits echo the single thickness of every Baumans stroke.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-suse: A crescent-wrench c swung wide open gives Baumans its swagger, and every stroke keeps a single thickness. SUSE's rope-thick curves and tipped-ladle bowls feel friendlier beside that firm hand.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-suse-mono: SUSE Mono reads approachably, with clear gaps in its curves and extra space on both sides of every letter. But Baumans writes like a pencil that never presses harder, and the two sit comfortably together.
